title: Problem-solving & reasoning
description: Meta-skills that show up across every problem: reading the problem, edge cases, tracing, invariants, complexity, refining brute force.

nodes.name: Reading the problem precisely
nodes.description: Extracting the exact requirements: distinctness, index vs value, output order, in-place, guarantees.

facets.recognize: Lists the exact output contract and constraints before coding.

misconceptions.desc: Wrong output format or order (sorted vs original order, 0- vs 1-based).
Ignored a stated constraint (in-place, O(1) space, guaranteed majority, sorted input).
Misread distinctness (second largest distinct, unique triplets).

nodes.name: Edge-case discovery
nodes.description: Finding inputs that break naive logic before submitting.

facets.recognize: Lists empty, single element, all equal, all negative, zeros, duplicates, k >= n, extreme values.
facets.adapt: Makes the general logic handle them instead of piling on special cases.

misconceptions.desc: Empty or single-element input not handled.
Negative numbers or zeros not handled.
Values at INT_MIN/INT_MAX or maximum n not handled.

nodes.name: Dry-running & state tracing
nodes.description: Simulating code by hand on a small input to find the step where it diverges.

facets.trace: Traces every variable on a small or failing input and locates the faulty step.

misconceptions.desc: Made repeated small edits and resubmits without tracing the failing input.
signals: several submits within minutes with tiny diffs

nodes.name: Loop invariants
nodes.description: Stating what remains true at every iteration and using it to argue correctness.

facets.explain: States the invariant for pointer/partition algorithms and uses it to justify each move.

misconceptions.desc: Cannot state the invariant of the algorithm they wrote.

nodes.name: Complexity analysis
nodes.description: Time and space of a solution, including hidden costs, and the complexity the constraints demand.

facets.recognize: Maps constraints to a target (n <= 1e5 needs O(n log n) or better).
facets.explain: States time and space including hidden costs (sort, erase, map operations, copies, recursion stack).

misconceptions.desc: Missed hidden costs: sort O(n log n), vector::erase O(n), set/map O(log n), copies.
Submitted O(n²) for n up to 1e5.
Miscounted space (forgot recursion stack or auxiliary arrays).

nodes.name: Brute -> better -> optimal refinement
nodes.description: Start correct, find the repeated work, remove it with a structure or an insight.

facets.recognize: Identifies the repeated work in a brute force and the tool that removes it.
facets.explain: Can derive the optimal step by step rather than recite it.

misconceptions.desc: Could not identify which repeated work to eliminate.
Wrote the optimal from memory but cannot derive or explain it.
